station_name: CLAVEY RIVER NEAR BUCK MEADOWS, CALIF.
township_range_section: SE¼NE¼ sec.35, T.1 N., R.17 E.
notes: Daily discharge, water year October 1967 to September 1968. No county printed. Other distances in the LOCATION paragraph: on right bank 300 ft upstream from Forest Service road bridge, 1.7 miles downstream from Quilty Creek, and 6 miles north of Buck Meadows Post Office. Remarks also mention the Tuolumne River basin (schematic diagram); the running head is San Joaquin River basin.
